title: TRIAERO Disc Road Frame A9
notes: Current exact-model manufacturer page identifies a Toray T700 + T800 carbon A9 frame, 1,090 g frame / 410 g fork / 320 g seatpost claims for size 52, BB86, fully internal routing and a frame package with integrated cockpit. The exact painted-frame page specifies 700x28C, and the complete-bike page says the A9 fits 28 mm tires. Manufacturer stiffness and power-transfer wording is marketing, not a controlled result.
